description: Na₅LiFe₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 71°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.79 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.88 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.84 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.80 Å. Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.60 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.42 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.31 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-57°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONaLiFeP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramid and corners with four ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂FeP tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramids and corners with three ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramids. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom.
